messages.subject: cleanGeno() applied in F2 intercross
parts:
Hi Dr. Broman,

I tried to use cleanGeno() in F2 intercross population and got the error " This function currently only works for crosses with two genotypes". Is there any other method I could use to remove the tight double crossovers in F2 intercross? 

I got a huge linkage map, ~10x bigger than we expected. I don't know what factors cause this problem.  Hope to get your guidance. I really appreciate!

Sincerely,
Chen

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl-disc] cleanGeno() applied in F2 intercross
parts:
The difficulty, with an F2, is that crossovers in adjacent intervals could be on different chromosomes, eg HAH could be AAB/BAA.

If you allow for genotyping error in estimating the map, by using error.prob=0.02, is the map still inflated?
Do you have a sense of the genotyping error rate?

karl
